description: Structural analysis + design decomposed. Determinate vs indeterminate, methods of joints/sections, deflection methods (virtual work, conjugate beam), influence lines, FEM workflow, dynamic analysis, seismic design philosophy.

sub_mechanisms.name: method_of_joints
sub_mechanisms.definition: FBD of each truss joint. ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0 at each joint. Solve sequentially.
sub_mechanisms.why: Find all member forces. Sequential: start at known. Standard truss method.

sub_mechanisms.name: method_of_sections
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cut truss; FBD of one half. Get 3 unknowns directly.
sub_mechanisms.why: When only certain members needed. Faster than joints for specific members. Standard truss method.

sub_mechanisms.name: beam_deflection_double_integration
sub_mechanisms.definition: EI·y'' = M(x). Integrate twice; apply boundary conditions for constants.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of beam deflection. Direct method. Standard tables for common cases.

sub_mechanisms.name: virtual_work_deflection
sub_mechanisms.definition: δ = ∫(Mm/EI) dx. Real M + virtual m for unit load at desired point.
sub_mechanisms.why: Powerful for complex loadings. Standard structural method. Works for trusses, beams, frames.

sub_mechanisms.name: stiffness_matrix_method
sub_mechanisms.definition: [K]{δ} = {F}. Assemble global stiffness from elements; solve.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of FEM. Handles indeterminate structures. Computer-implementable. Modern structural analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: influence_line
sub_mechanisms.definition: Plot of response at point due to unit load at varying position.
sub_mechanisms.why: Bridge design: where to place truck loads for max stress. Standard for moving loads.

sub_mechanisms.name: plastic_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Limit state: structure fails when enough plastic hinges form to create mechanism.
sub_mechanisms.why: Steel structures. Higher capacity than elastic analysis. Modern codes use. Ductility required.

sub_mechanisms.name: P_delta_effects
sub_mechanisms.definition: Axial load × lateral displacement → additional moment. Significant for slender columns.
sub_mechanisms.why: Second-order analysis. Standard for tall buildings under wind/seismic. Direct analysis method in AISC 360.

sub_mechanisms.name: response_spectrum_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Plot peak response (SDOF) vs natural period for earthquake ground motion.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard seismic analysis. Building modes excited per spectrum. Design codes specify spectra per site + occupancy.

sub_mechanisms.name: capacity_design_seismic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Force ductile elements to fail first; protect brittle. Beams yield before columns; foundation last.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern seismic philosophy. Predictable failure path. Ductility absorbs energy. Standard since 1970s research.

sub_mechanisms.name: LRFD_load_combinations
sub_mechanisms.definition: Load + Resistance Factor Design. φ × R_n ≥ Σ γ_i × Q_i. Probabilistic safety.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern code basis (since 1980s). Different factors for dead, live, wind, seismic. Replaces ASD allowable stress.

sub_mechanisms.name: performance_based_design
sub_mechanisms.definition: Design for specific performance objectives at specific hazard levels.
sub_mechanisms.why: Beyond code-minimum. 'Operational at 50-year quake; collapse prevention at 2475-year'. Modern engineering for critical facilities.

derivation_rules.name: indeterminate_structures_need_compatibility
derivation_rules.why: Equilibrium insufficient. Indeterminate: redundant forces from compatibility (deflection at supports = 0). Standard methods: force, displacement.

derivation_rules.name: P_delta_critical_for_tall_buildings
if: building has significant lateral displacement under load
derivation_rules.why: Axial × lateral disp = additional moment → more disp → more moment. Converges if stable. Critical for tall steel buildings. Standard in AISC.

derivation_rules.name: capacity_design_predictable_failure
then: failure happens in ductile elements first
derivation_rules.why: Beams yield in flexure (ductile); columns kept elastic; foundation strongest. Hierarchy. Energy dissipates in beams. Standard modern seismic.

derivation_rules.name: LRFD_probabilistic_safety
then: safety factors reflect probabilistic load + resistance
derivation_rules.why: φ < 1 for resistance uncertainty. γ > 1 for load uncertainty. Modern reliability-based design. Probabilistic foundation.

derivation_rules.name: performance_based_design_beyond_code_minimum
derivation_rules.why: Code-minimum: collapse prevention at design earthquake. PBD: operational at higher hazards. Standard for critical facilities. Cost: explicit modelling.
